summary: Authorized short PostgreSQL fixture has its own artifact and durable roots.
details: Bootstrap resolves Git common dir to fixture clone root. The authorized s clone therefore needs regular copied verified build/cache under s/artifacts, matching earlier independently owned e/p fixtures.
action: Confirmed s/artifacts build/cache/tmp permitted and protected during active use; durable cluster remains s/development/runtime. Require copied hashes/provenance, no symlinks/global installation, main a3 scratch/evidence unchanged.
outcome: Fixture setup prerequisite resolved without weakening ownership/deletion/retention rules or touching original runtime.
